nodes.title: FACESWAP TEST - read me
widgets_values:
# FACESWAP + REFMOD CHARACTER REPLACE

Two mechanisms, one identity source.

**Identity = the RefMod.** `Load H3 RefMods` -> `mod_1` carries the whole character:
face shape, hair, skin, body shape, clothing, wardrobe and accessories. The prompt
calls it "the attached character reference". A mod has **no `<Picture n>` tag** and
no name, so it cannot be addressed by number in the text.

**Mechanism = the FaceSwap LoRA.** `Power Lora Loader` -> `lora_1` =
`SS_FaceSwap_MiniMax_H3_REF2VA.safetensors` (on, strength 1).
https://civitai.red/models/2940916/faceswap-minimax-ref2va?modelVersionId=3329609

**Motion = `<Video 1>`.** The timeline source window supplies the action, pose,
timing, camera, framing, background and lighting.

Character Replace is **OFF** - the LoRA and the mod do the swap, there are no masked
windows here.

## The competing picture was removed

Common References used to hold a `<Picture 1>` portrait. It had to go for the mod to
own the character: a reference image **beats a mod in an argument** - it arrives at
full resolution through H3's native reference path, while the mod is an unnamed
latent blob appended to `minimax_refs`. With both connected you get a face swap off
the picture, and the mod only nudges it.

Re-add a picture in the Director's Common References if you want a second identity
channel - but expect that image to lead and the mod to follow.

## Why the old prompt gave a face swap

It asked for one: `<Subject 1>: face_transfer`, "`<Picture 1>` gives the face;
`<Video 1>` gives everything else". The new prompt names every attribute the mod has
to supply and states the face is only the first layer.

## If the character still does not carry over

1. `strength_1` on `Load H3 RefMods` = 1.0, `copies_1` = 2-3.
2. `retention` on `Apply H3 RefMod` = 1.0.
3. Use a mod in `encode` (**Full Reference**) mode, not the pooled/compressed mode.
   `people/flaffy02` is `encode` with a full-res pool (1536x992px); `people/elf_girl`
   is the same at 864x1536px.
4. Watch the console for `RefMod: N reference block(s) appended to every segment.`
   If that line is missing, nothing was harvested and the output is not a RefMod
   result.

nodes.title: RefMod identity preset
widgets_values:
# Character Replace example (RefMod identity + SAM3 masks)

## Quick start

1. Drop your source video into `ComfyUI/input` and point the timeline Source Video at it
   (currently `character_replace_source_example.mp4`).
2. `Load H3 RefMods` slot 1 = your character mod, `strength_1` 1.0, `copies_1` 1.
   Keep the mod images cropped to the person - rooms and furniture in the reference
   leak into the render as content.
3. Replace is already ON: two 5-second windows, SAM3 auto-masks, render = `anchor`,
   audio policy = `source`, lead 12, grow 1, feather 1.
4. Use `Test mask` on a window and PICK the subject with click points. Points are far
   more reliable than text - the `the woman` prompt in `sam_prompts` is only a fallback.
   Copy the points to the other windows, then render.
5. Watch the console: `FELL BACK to plain RV2V` means the mask failed for that window
   and the render will not replace anything.

## Which channel owns the outfit

The RefMod reference carries everything its images show - face, clothing, rooms. If the
outfit should come from the reference, keep `wardrobe:` matching it. If the outfit must
come from the prompt, crop the mod images so they do not show a conflicting outfit.

## Perf section

`verbose_logging` prints the pack's own DEBUG diagnostics for a run (phase timings,
cache decisions, SAM3 attempts, reference counts). `MINIMAX_DIRECTOR_VERBOSE=1/0`
forces it on or off server-wide.

# Diffusion Model Pipeline / LoRA Switch Config

This workflow routes between three model paths (FL2VA T2V/I2V, REF2VA, and H3 Fast Video), each with its own LoRA and sampling settings, feeding into a single **Model Switch** node for selection at runtime.

## Model #1 - FL2VA (T2V/I2V)

- **Base model**: `minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8...`
- **LoRA**: `minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_4step_v1.0_768p_comfyui_bf...` (strength: 1.00)
- **Sampling shift**: Video 6.00 / Audio 3.00

## Model #2 - REF2VA

- **Base model**: `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int...`
- **LoRA**: `minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.sa...` (strength: 1.00)
- **Sampling shift**: Video 12.00 / Audio 3.00

## Model #3 - H3 Fast Video

- **Base model**: `minimax_h3_fastvideo_vsa_dat...`
- **LoRA**: bypassed by default (this model is already a speed-optimized diffusion model, so no turbo LoRA is needed)
- **Optional**: users can un-bypass the LoRA node to stack the FL2VA turbo LoRA on top of the fast video model. This may speed things up further but will likely introduce quality deficits.
- **Sampling shift**: Video 12.00 / Audio 3.00

## Model Switch

- **Node**: Impact-Pack Model Switch

# Diffusion Model Pipeline / LoRA Switch Config

This workflow routes between three model paths (FL2VA T2V/I2V, REF2VA, and H3 Fast Video), each with its own LoRA and sampling settings, feeding into a single **Model Switch** node for selection at runtime.

## Model #1 - FL2VA (T2V/I2V)

- **Base model**: `minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8...`
- **LoRA**: `minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_4step_v1.0_768p_comfyui_bf...` (strength: 1.00)
- **Sampling shift**: Video 6.00 / Audio 3.00

## Model #2 - REF2VA

- **Base model**: `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int...`
- **LoRA**: `minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.sa...` (strength: 1.00)
- **Sampling shift**: Video 12.00 / Audio 3.00

## Model #3 - H3 Fast Video

- **Base model**: `minimax_h3_fastvideo_vsa_dat...`
- **LoRA**: bypassed by default (this model is already a speed-optimized diffusion model, so no turbo LoRA is needed)
- **Optional**: users can un-bypass the LoRA node to stack the FL2VA turbo LoRA on top of the fast video model. This may speed things up further but will likely introduce quality deficits.
- **Sampling shift**: Video 12.00 / Audio 3.00

## Model Switch

- **Node**: Impact-Pack Model Switch
- **Inputs**: up to 5 model inputs (input1–input5), only inputs 1–3 populated here
- **select**: 1 (currently routing Model #1)
- **sel_mode**: `select_on_execution`

## Notes

- Each path uses `ModelSamplingMiniMax` to set video/audio shift values before hitting the switch.
- Feeds into KSamplerSelect (sampler: `er_sde`) and BasicScheduler (scheduler: `simple`) downstream.
- ## IMPORTANT: IF you are switching between models using the switch node, make sure you change the MODEL TYPE in the DIRECTOR node configuration.

extra.description: SFW ref2va (Reference to Video) example: one continuous golden-hour forest run, 3 segments x 7s (21s total @24fps). Subject 1 is an athletic elf woman sprinting through dense forest, clearing a creek and a log, vaulting onto a high branch, then stopping at a cliff edge to view the vast forest. Dynamic cinematic camera (orbit / tracking / low-angle pan). No dialogue, no music - only exertion breaths, movement grunts, clothes rustle, footfalls, forest ambience. To use: upload a headshot as Picture 1 and a full-body character sheet as Picture 2 in the Director's common references, then generate (Export all). Requires the H3 REF2VA model selected on the ImpactSwitch (select 2 = MODEL_2 / ref2va path).
